title: surge
description: 숫자, 가격, 감정, 인파, 전력 등이 갑자기 세게 늘어나거나 밀려오는 상황에 자주 쓰입니다.
"a surge of emotion / anger / energy" : "감정의 물결, 분노의 폭발, 에너지가 솟구침"
주로 숫자, 인기, 감정, 에너지, 물리적 현상 등이 갑자기 강하게 증가하거나 밀려올 때 사용됩니다.
"surge to ~" : "~까지 급등하다 / 급상승하다" (특정 수치나 위치에 도달할 때)
예: "The stock surged to a record high." / "A surge of excitement filled the room."

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you see what happened to the stock this morning?
lines.meaning: 오늘 아침 그 주식 어떻게 됐는지 봤어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah, there was a sudden surge right after the earnings announcement.
lines.meaning: 응, 실적 발표 직후에 갑자기 급등하더라.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I wish I had bought more yesterday.
lines.meaning: 어제 더 사둘 걸 그랬네.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How high did the temperature go today?
lines.meaning: 오늘 기온이 얼마나 올랐어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It surged to 37 degrees. That’s a new record for November.
lines.meaning: 37도까지 급등했어. 11월 신기록이네.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The new café is completely packed.
lines.meaning: 새로 생긴 카페가 완전 가득 찼어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I know. There was a huge surge of customers right after they posted on social media.
lines.meaning: 그렇지. SNS에 올린 직후 손님들이 갑자기 엄청 몰려들었어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The crowd went crazy when the final goal was scored.
lines.meaning: 마지막 골이 들어가니까 관중석이 난리가 났더라.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah, you could feel the surge of energy through the whole stadium.
lines.meaning: 응, 경기장 전체에 에너지가 확 밀려오는 게 느껴졌어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I almost cried during the final scene.
lines.meaning: 마지막 장면에서 울 뻔했어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Same. I felt a sudden surge of emotion. It was so powerful.
lines.meaning: 나도. 감정이 갑자기 확 밀려오더라. 정말 강렬했어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why did the power go out in our building?
lines.meaning: 우리 건물 전기가 왜 나갔어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: There was a power surge in the area. A few people had the same problem.
lines.meaning: 그 지역에 전력 급상승이 있었대. 몇 명 더 같은 문제가 생겼다고 하더라.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our team was in fifth place yesterday.
lines.meaning: 우리 팀이 어제만 해도 5위였는데.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I know. After today’s wins, we surged to second place.
lines.meaning: 그러게. 오늘 연승하면서 2위까지 급상승했어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our website crashed last night.
lines.meaning: 어젯밤에 우리 웹사이트가 다운됐어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A celebrity mentioned us, so there was a massive surge in traffic.
lines.meaning: 유명인이 우리 얘기해서 트래픽이 엄청나게 폭증했거든.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Gas prices are getting ridiculous.
lines.meaning: 기름값이 말도 안 되게 오르고 있어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They surged again this week. I paid almost 20 percent more than last month.
lines.meaning: 이번 주에 또 급등했어. 지난달보다 거의 20퍼센트 더 냈네.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How many people applied for the internship this year?
lines.meaning: 올해 인턴십에 몇 명이나 지원했어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: There was a huge surge in applications after the company raised the salary.
lines.meaning: 회사에서 급여를 올린 뒤로 지원자가 갑자기 엄청 늘어났어.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Makes sense. Everyone wants better pay.
lines.meaning: 그럴 만하네. 다들 더 나은 급여를 원하니까.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I almost yelled at him during the meeting.
lines.meaning: 회의 중에 그 사람한테 소리 지를 뻔했어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I felt a surge of anger too when he blamed the whole team.
lines.meaning: 그 사람이 팀 전체를 탓할 때 나도 분노가 확 치밀더라.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Have you seen this month's numbers?
lines.meaning: 이번 달 숫자 봤어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah, there's been a huge surge in online orders since the sale started.
lines.meaning: 응, 세일 시작하고 나서 온라인 주문이 급증했어.

conversations.title: 스포츠 경기 중 분위기가 바뀔 때

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They were losing by ten points at halftime.
lines.meaning: 전반 끝났을 때 10점 차로 지고 있었어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: But then they had a huge surge in the third quarter and took the lead.
lines.meaning: 그런데 3쿼터에 갑자기 엄청난 기세로 앞서가기 시작하더라.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You look unusually energetic this morning.
lines.meaning: 오늘 아침 유난히 에너지 넘쳐 보이네.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I had a strong coffee and suddenly felt a surge of energy. Let's get this done.
lines.meaning: 커피 진하게 마셨더니 갑자기 에너지가 솟구쳤어. 이거 빨리 끝내자.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The subway was insane this morning.
lines.meaning: 오늘 아침 지하철 진짜 미쳤어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: There was a surge of people because of the concert nearby.
lines.meaning: 근처에서 콘서트 있어서 사람들이 한꺼번에 몰렸거든.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That new café is completely packed every day now.
lines.meaning: 그 새 카페가 요즘 매일 사람들로 꽉 차 있어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I know. They got a huge surge in popularity after that influencer posted about it.
lines.meaning: 그렇지. 그 인플루언서가 올린 이후로 인기가 급상승했잖아.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The number of cases is rising again.
lines.meaning: 확진자 수가 또 늘어나고 있어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah, experts are warning about another surge this winter.
lines.meaning: 응, 전문가들이 이번 겨울에 또 한 번 급증할 수 있다고 경고하고 있어.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: We should be more careful then.
lines.meaning: 그럼 더 조심해야겠네.
